title: Normalized square existence for a uniformizer quotient
statement: For prime l, finite intermediate E, a maximal-ideal uniformizer pi, n, a morphism f:X -> S, and an integral full universal right-derived model R, the actual quotient map O_E -> O_E/(pi)^(n+1) admits a full-unit-normalized RestrictionSquare between R and the canonical quotient right-derived model.

proof.text: For the actual coefficient map, take the normalized derived scalar/pullback isomorphism supplied by internal_pull_normalization_exists. Uniqueness of right adjoints gives restrictPush, an isomorphism between exact restriction followed by canonical derived direct image in the two coefficient systems. normalized_scalar_restriction_push identifies its hom with the geometric right mate of the canonical restriction/pullback comparison. No flatness or finite quotient resolution is used for square existence.

Transport the derived geometric adjunctions along the exact-left-derived comparison. The generic mate-left-transport identity identifies this geometric mate with the mate for mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction. The ordinary restriction/pullback mate is comapLowerStarIso. Apply derived_mate_factors to obtain the full cochain-unit normalization, identifying chainDerivedUnit with the canonicalDiagonalUnit formula.

Use rightDerivedUnique for the canonical integral derived model and the supplied model R. Whisker this unit-preserving isomorphism with exact restriction and compose it with the square. Naturality and rightDerivedNatTrans_app transport the full cochain-unit equation to R. Specialize this general construction to quotientMap l E pi n.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_uniformizer_restriction_square
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (R : DiagonalRightDerived
      (CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) f)) :
    Nonempty (RestrictionSquare (quotientMap l E π n) f R
      (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived
        (CondensedRing.lowerStar
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n)) f)))
